text.p: Zuercher Kantonalbank (ZKB) Brokerage Research said it was recommending the shares of Swiss chemical company Clariant as a buy in view of the recent sideways trading trend.
Clariant's shares have been trading within a 65 Swiss franc range for about a month, clearly underperforming the market, the ZKB report said.
It said the sideways pattern was clearly a pause in the medium-term upward trend.

"Even if the consolidation lingers somewhat and the lower level of 885 (francs per share) were to again be tested, it would be followed by a break to the upside," ZKB said in its Daily Market Opinion.
Clariant's shares were two francs higher at 945 at 0840 GMT. The Swiss Market Index was 36.1 points higher at 5,698.0.
